crossRefs.note: The fear of Yahweh is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the evil way, and the perverse mouth.
We have heard of the pride of Moab, that he is very proud; even of his arrogance, his pride, and his wrath. His…
I have heard the reproach of Moab, and the insults of the children of Ammon, with which they have reproached my people…
“Now deck yourself with excellency and dignity. Array yourself with honor and majesty.
For though Yahweh is high, yet he looks after the lowly; but he knows the proud from afar.
Before destruction the heart of man is proud, but before honor is humility.
There is a generation, oh how lofty are their eyes! Their eyelids are lifted up.
The lofty looks of man will be brought low, the arrogance of men will be bowed down, and Yahweh alone will be exalted…
For there will be a day of Yahweh of Armies for all that is proud and arrogant, and for all that is lifted up; and it…
Now I, Nebuchadnezzar, praise and extol and honor the King of heaven; for all his works are truth, and his ways…
For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.”
But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”

people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

translations.web: “We have heard of the pride of Moab. He is very proud in his loftiness, his pride, his arrogance, and the arrogance of his heart.
translations.bsb: We have heard of Moab’s pomposity, his exceeding pride and conceit, his proud arrogance and haughtiness of heart.
translations.kjv: We have heard the pride of Moab, (he is exceeding proud) his loftiness, and his arrogancy, and his pride, and the haughtiness of his heart.
translations.asv: We have heard of the pride of Moab, that he is very proud; his loftiness, and his pride, and his arrogancy, and the haughtiness of his heart.
